newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE puts rise as AEX hesitates.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE puts rise as AEX hesitates.

text.p: Dutch put options rose on Monday as the AEX hesitated just around its Friday closing level, albeit after its had set a new intra-day high.
Notably, puts in the AEX index outnumbered calls by a ratio of about 2.5 to one.

However, traders said it did not detract from an overall bullish sentiment as the puts were predominantly out of the money, the most actively traded being the Dec 620. In the at-the-money area, calls continued to outnumber puts.
"We've got more calls than puts at the money, so the short-term at least seems to be up," one trader said.
A number of put buyers were also interested in slightly out-of-the-money strike prices in January, but again traders believed these were speculative gambles, rather than firm predictions.
In the options exchange as a whole, calls continued to outnumber puts by about two to one. The hesitancy of financial stocks encouraged healthy call buying of ABN and ING.
